meta.name: Nightwatch
meta.description: Martin, a law student, takes up a job as a nightwatchman at a mortuary to fund his studies. But the mortuary harbours a dark secret, and he has to find the truth before he is implicated in a serial murder case.
meta.slogan: They are looking for a night watchman. Martin is not afraid of the dark but he just has one problem... he got the job!
